certificate_emission.measurement: Measured from emitted_decision_certificate on completed adapter results; a pass requires a first-class decision certificate artifact.

certificate_expiry.measurement: Same signed certificate verified twice against the pinned public key: within TTL it is accepted; past expires_at verification reports expired with verdict_expired_recertification_required and licenses nothing.

determinism.measurement: Identical decision across N=20 repeated runs; pass^k reports the probability that all k sampled runs are successful.
